adjudication.rationale: In the new API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` is called without any try/catch, so invalid/malformed request bodies will throw a ZodError and bubble up as an unhandled exception (typically a 500 in a Next.js API route). Likewise, `symmetricDecrypt(...)` and the subsequent `JSON.parse(...)` are not guarded; bad ciphertext, missing/empty `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, or non-JSON plaintext will throw and also produce a 500 instead of a controlled 4xx response.
